description.zh-CN: 把任意文档变成私人知识库的桌面 AI 工作台：本地拖入文件自动向量化，聊天引用原文出处；内置本地模型引擎，也能接 OpenAI/Claude/开源模型的 Key。
description.en: Desktop AI workspace that turns any documents into a private knowledge base — drop files in, they are vectorized automatically and answers cite their sources; ships with a built-in local model engine and can also use OpenAI/Claude/open-model API keys.

runtime.note: Self-contained Electron desktop app (bundled runtime, no system Node). Windows 10+ x64/ARM64 (official docs target Windows Home/Pro, "Current User" install only — all-users installs are unsupported); macOS installers for Apple Silicon and Intel. During install it downloads the built-in LLM engine / GPU support files from the vendor CDN, so outbound network is needed.

direct-install.label: Official direct install (GitHub Releases)
direct-install.note: Installer route: Windows runs the official NSIS silent mode (/S, current user), macOS mounts the dmg and copies AnythingLLM.app; steps contain both platform packages and are filtered by machine arch (arm64 machines pick the -Arm64/-Silicon variants).

proxy-install.note: Same packages; the download layer prefers proxy channels in CN and falls back to direct automatically.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter (one key, every model)
openrouter.notes: Keys are entered in the app UI (Settings → AI Providers) and persisted by AnythingLLM into its SQLite store under the official data directory (docs installation-desktop/storage) — AiBOX cannot inject them directly. configTarget points at that store (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/anythingllm-desktop/anythingllm.db).

anthropic.label: Anthropic official API (Claude)
anthropic.notes: Same storage model as openrouter (app UI entry, SQLite store).

openai.label: OpenAI official API
openai.notes: Same storage model as openrouter (app UI entry, SQLite store).

ollama.label: Local models — built-in engine or Ollama (free, offline)
ollama.notes: Desktop includes a built-in local LLM engine (Lemonade + llama.cpp; GPU support files pulled from the vendor CDN during install) and can also connect to an external Ollama instance (official docs; auto-detected). No key required.

upgrade.notes: Check = local --version vs the tag the daily probe records; upgrade = download the newer official installer and run it over the existing one (in-app update banner also offers the download), storage and workspaces persist.

steps: Windows (official silent flags): run "Uninstall AnythingLLM.exe /S" from %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\AnythingLLM — keeps all data; add /DELETE_DATA=yes only if you want to wipe everything
macOS: quit the app and drag AnythingLLM.app to the Trash (or `brew uninstall --cask anythingllm`; add --zap to also delete app data)
To fully reset, delete the data directory (see residualPaths) — this removes workspaces, documents and chat history
uninstall.notes: Uninstalling the app does NOT delete the data directory by default (official uninstall docs); /DELETE_DATA=yes or manual deletion of %APPDATA%\anythingllm-desktop is irreversible.

risk.onUninstall: All workspaces, uploaded/parsed documents, the vector database, chat history and downloaded local models live in the data directory and are deleted with it — `/DELETE_DATA=yes` does this permanently. Back that folder up first. / 所有工作区、已上传文档、向量库、聊天记录与本地下载模型都在数据目录里，删除即永久丢失——请先备份该文件夹。
